brief: Review the open defect register for Pinecrest Junction (SUB-SGW-659) to establish what was raised, when, why it was deferred, and whether the reason for deferral still holds. If any outstanding work falls into categories 1 to 3 regarding heat-shedding ability, complete it before the event begins wherever crew capacity allows. For ageing units that cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure.
